goal: Deprecate encrypting existing wallets via RPC to push users toward creating encrypted wallets upfront
Prevent fund loss from restored backups that predate key generation during post-creation encryption
Avoid leaving unencrypted private key remnants on disk and changing descriptor spending conditions
reviewability: A rebase is needed to resolve a silent merge conflict in tests and polish documentation
agreement: Strong support with multiple ACKs and no objections
Creating encrypted wallets upfront and sending funds over is cleaner and safer (pablomartin4btc)
Reported a silent test merge conflict causing an indentation error after initial ACK (achow101)
Minor suggestions open on documentation updates and release notes (maflcko, fanquake)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because encrypting wallets post-creation can invalidate older backups and risk fund loss on restore
It prevents unexpected spending condition changes on imported descriptors and plaintext keys on disk
